newsitem.title: USA: CILCORP adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: CILCORP adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: CILCORP Inc said Tuesday its board adopted a shareholder rights plan designed to encourage anyone seeking to acquire the company to negotiate with its board and to ensure fair and equal treatment for all shareholders.
President Robet Viets said he was not aware of any effort to acquire control of the company.
The board declared the rights as a non-cash dividend to holders of record at the close of business on November 12.

Under the plan, shareholders will get one right for each share of common stock of the company held, and that right will entitle the holder to buy one-hundredth of a share of preferred stock under certain circumstances.

CILCORP, a holding company whose business involves the generation, sale and distribution of electric energy, said it could redeem the rights at $0.001 per right before they become exercisable. The rights will expire November 12, 2006.
